title: Watercolor Procreate Brush Set
author: FinsandFiction
description:
Create soft, painterly watercolor artwork in Procreate with this handmade digital brush toolkit. This set was designed for artists, illustrators, and digital creatives who want a natural watercolor look with easy-to-use brushes, realistic paper texture, and ready-to-paint color palettes.
Use this set to create fruit illustrations, florals, clip art, patterns, art prints, social media graphics, greeting cards, digital stickers, and other soft handmade-style artwork.
This toolkit includes watercolor brushes for washes, pigment texture, soft edges, painterly strokes, detail work, and layered color effects. It also includes blender brushes, a sponge texture brush, a clean eraser, watercolor paper texture canvases, and curated color palettes to help you start creating right away.
What’s Included
This set includes 40 total Procreate tools and resources:
21 Watercolor Brushes
For soft washes, layered pigment, wet edges, dry brush texture, painterly strokes, and detailed watercolor effects.
5 Blender Brushes
For soft blending, smoothing, pushing pigment, and creating gentle watercolor transitions.
1 Sponge Brush
Great for adding organic texture, stippling, background effects, and soft pigment variation.
1 Perfect Eraser
A clean eraser brush for refining edges, removing texture, and shaping details.
5 Paper Texture Canvases
Ready-to-use Procreate canvases with watercolor paper texture.
5 Color Palettes
Curated watercolor-inspired palettes for soft, cohesive artwork.
PDF Guide
Includes simple installation and usage instructions.
File Types Included
Your download includes:
.brushset file for Procreate
.swatches files for Procreate palettes
Procreate canvas files for paper textures
PDF guide / instructions
This is a digital product. No physical item will be shipped.
Compatibility
This product is made for:
Procreate on iPad
You will need the Procreate app installed to use the brush set, palettes, and canvas files. An Apple Pencil or compatible stylus is recommended.
These files are not designed for Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, GoodNotes, or other drawing apps.
Suggested Uses
Watercolor illustrations
Fruit artwork
Florals and botanicals
Digital clip art
Surface pattern design
Art prints
Greeting cards
Planner graphics
Digital stickers
Social media graphics
Product mockups
Handmade-style branding elements
Creative projects and design assets
